# Editor Assistant Instructions for the ALttP Port

The coding standards for this repository live in a tool-neutral location, so
every code assistant shares one source of truth:

**[docs/contributing/coding-standards.md](../docs/contributing/coding-standards.md)**

Read and follow that file when generating or editing code in this repo. It
covers file organization, the export/destructuring patterns, naming, React
conventions, and testing.

For project architecture, the C to WASM to TS bridge, and build/run workflows, see
[docs/architecture/overview.md](../docs/architecture/overview.md) and
[docs/architecture/wasm-bridge.md](../docs/architecture/wasm-bridge.md).
